subject: planner: bug fix for compareCandidates (#64525)
summary: Reviewed the single-line change in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` within `compareCandidates()` skyline pruning: in the non-comparable case, RHS now only wins when `predicateResult < -1` (symmetrical with LHS `> 1`), aligning with the surrounding comment that risk alone should not decide a winner.
